definitions.explanation: A beverage made from tea leaves. In Japanese, {茶|ちゃ} typically refers to Japanese green tea by default, though it can refer to tea in general.
The color brown, named after the color of tea. Used in compound words like {茶色|ちゃいろ} (brown color).

examples.english: Would you like to have some tea?
In Japan, people drink tea after meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れましょうか→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}い→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}く→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧。

examples.english: Tea is said to be a healthy drink.

notes:
USAGE: The polite form ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ} is more commonly used in everyday speech. Without any modifier, {茶|ちゃ}/⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ} typically means Japanese green tea (⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧).

TYPES OF TEA:
- ⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧ (green tea)
- ⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧ (black tea)
- ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧ (barley tea)
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (matcha, powdered green tea)
- ⟦ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}→ウーロン茶：11337_uuroncha⟧ (oolong tea)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to make/brew tea)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to serve tea)
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧/{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (tea ceremony)

IDIOM: {茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{濁|にご}す→濁す：19579_nigosu⟧ means 'to evade the issue' or 'to gloss over something'.

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
- Serving ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ} to a ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ on arrival is basic hospitality at home and in offices; it is ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧, not offered as a choice.
- Japanese tea is brewed in a ⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧ and drunk from a handleless ⟦{湯呑|ゆの}み→湯呑み：04480_yunomi⟧.
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{茶|ちゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ("to go for tea") means meeting at a ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧ or café, whatever is actually ordered.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧ (brown), ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony), ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧ (coffee shop)
